verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics middleware/framework for communication, computation graph management, and tooling (pub/sub, services, actions, CLI tools, security, QoS) — it is not a fleet management or OTA deployment platform. Staged rollouts and rollback of software updates across a robot fleet is a distinct product category (e.g., fleet management/OTA tools built on top of ROS), so this axis does not apply to ROS 2 itself.
